items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: one of the most prominent developers of the bass trombone in the popular field was a fellow by the name of Roberts

ctx.x: Did it give a different feel to you -- to the trombone section to have a bass trombone?

Oh, yes. It gives a good heavy bottom, and I think one of the most prominent developers of the bass trombone in the popular field was a fellow by the name of Roberts. And he's out here in California now still playing bass trombone in the studios and places. Very good. He's a terrific musician.
I see a trombone player here named Leon Cox who I've never heard of before. Who was he?
